title: Creating a Successful Game in 1000xResist with Remy Siu of Sunset Visitor — Success: Part 6
summary: Divya talks with Remy Siu, creative director at Sunset Visitor and lead on the narrative game 1000xResist, about how a small writers' room built one of the most formally distinct games of recent years. He gets into his background in devised theatre and music composition, how the team collaborates by writing alone then riffing together, what it cost to do performing arts in Vancouver, and the spatial-design choices that make the apartments feel like apartments instead of levels.
topics: humor and tragedy alongside each other

intents.display: to hear the team behind 1000xresist talk about making the game
to think about what it costs to make experimental art outside the standard pipeline
